documented_vendor_differences.ARISTA_EOS: Supports openconfig-evpn (/network-instances/network-instance[name=default]/evpn/state) and eos_native Sysdb/Smash/LANZ paths; CPU/Memory/Environment use OpenConfig models.
documented_vendor_differences.CISCO_IOS_XR: Uses Cisco-IOS-XR-*-oper native YANG modules (statsd, pfi-im-cmd, ipv4-bgp, qos-ma, controller-optics, wdsysmon); optical power in native controller-optics-oper is expressed in 0.01 dBm integer units.
documented_vendor_differences.CISCO_IOS_XE: Uses Cisco-IOS-XE-*-oper native YANG modules (interfaces-oper, bgp-oper, environment-oper, transceiver-oper, process-cpu-oper); never emits IOS XR paths.
documented_vendor_differences.JUNIPER_JUNOS: Uses Junos Telemetry Interface (JTI) /junos/system/linecard/* and /junos/services/bgp/* native sensor paths alongside OpenConfig.
